annotations.text:
Sarvekshan — school audit platform, desktop web.
Three connected screens: district overview, searchable school index, and a school's report card.
Built on what actually works in Linear, Vercel and ProPublica's public databases — persistent nav, flat surfaces with hairline borders and no drop shadows, hierarchy from font weight rather than size, 56px rows, summary up top and detail one click deep.

OVERVIEW
What a coordinator opens on. Four numbers, the survival curve, and the reversion list — repairs that were fixed and have broken again. That list is the thing no other tool produces.

SCHOOLS
The ProPublica pattern: search-led, sortable, comparable. Every school in the district is listed whether or not we have worked there — and an unaudited school shows as a visible grey gap rather than being quietly left out.

REPORT CARD
The audit itself. Grant reconciliation reads left to right — sanctioned, released, accounted, actually seen on site — and the drop from ₹50,000 to ₹13,000 is the finding. Right column is the evidence: same spot photographed over time, the voice note, and the follow-up checks.
